rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: ❌ 'Vector addition is simply adding components' ✅ While true for components, the *geometric* interpretation requires head-to-tail placement; you must not just add scalar magnitudes.  ·  ❌ 'Subtraction is same as addition' ✅ Subtraction is vector addition of the first vector and the negative (reversed direction) of the second vector: A - B = A + (-B).

rows.label: Study notes
rows.text: **Vector:** A quantity having both magnitude and direction. Represented as arrow or bold letter: **a** or a⃗.  ·  **Scalar:** A quantity with magnitude only (mass, temperature, time).  ·  **Vector addition:** Triangle law: place tail of b at head of a; resultant closes triangle. Parallelogram law: diagonal from common tail.
